div.head: VI As 8.1
div.ab: Octauum est ut conueniamus semper ad unum mensem, si possimus et licitum habeamus, per hindemen (hyndenos homines) et eos qui decimas custodiunt, sic cum bucellorum impletione sic aliter sicut poterimus, et sciamus, quid edictorum nostrorum compleatur; et habeant ipsi duodecim homines conuictum suum simul et pascant se sicut deceat, et remanens diuidant pro amore Dei.

Eahtoðe, þæt we us gegaderian á emban ænne monað, gif we mágon ⁊ ǽmton habban, þa hyndenmenn ⁊ þa þe ða teoþunge bewítan, swa mid byttfyllinge swa elles swa us tóanhágie, ⁊ witen, hwæt ure gecwydræddene gelæst sy; ⁊ habban þa XII menn heora metscype tógædere ⁊ fedan hig swa swa hig sylfe wyrðe múnon, ⁊ dælon ealle þa metelafe Godes þances.

Eahtoðe: Þæt we us gegaderian á emban ænne monað, gif we mágon ⁊ ǽmton habban, þa hyndenmenn ⁊ þa þe ða teoþunge bewitan, swa mid byttfyllinge swa elles swa us tóanhágie, ⁊ witen hwæt ure gecwydræddene gelæst sy; ⁊ habban þa XII menn heora metscype tógædere ⁊ fedan hig swa swa hig sylfe wyrðe múnon, ⁊ dælon ealle þa metelafe Godes þances.

Eighth: We, the officials of the hundred-groups and those who have charge of the bodies of ten, shall assemble once every month, if we have leisure and can do so — whether it be when the butts are being filled, or on any other occasion that may be convenient for us; and we shall take cognisance of how our various statutes are being observed. Twelve men shall then have their dinners together, and they shall have such food as they themselves think right, and they shall give away all the fragments, for the love of God.

Achtens, dass wir uns je nach einem Monat versammeln, wenn wir können und Musse haben, [nämlich] die Hundertverbandsvorsteher und die, welche die Zehntschaften beaufsichtigen, sei es beim Büttenfüllen [zum künftigen Gildenfest], sei es, wie es uns sonst passen mag, und vermerken, was von unserer Übereinkunft erfüllt worden ist; und es sollen die 12 [lies 11] Männer ihre Mahlzeit zusammen erhalten [auf Kosten der Genossenschaft] und essen, so wie sie selbst für würdig erachten, und alle die Speisereste [Armen] vertheilen um Gottes willen.

Eighthly, that we gather once a month, if we can and have leisure, [namely] the heads of the hundreds and those who supervise the tithings, whether at the filling of the butts [for a coming guild-feast] or however else it may suit us, and note what of our agreement has been fulfilled; and the 12 [read 11] men are to have their meal together [at the fellowship's expense] and feed themselves as they themselves think fit, and distribute all the leftover food [to the poor] for the love of God.
div.note: ‘þurh’ before ‘þa hyndenmenn’ should perhaps be supplied from Quadr.; H's ‘XII’ should be corrected to ‘XI’ (Liebermann).
